skill_name: Tell me about a unique painting by Salvador Dali
workflow: Salvador Dali is known for his unique surrealist paintings, some of which depict strange dreamscapes and dreamlike figures. One of his most iconic and unique works is The Persistence of Memory, which was painted in 1931. This painting is physically composed of soft, melting pocket watches, average objects, an ant, and a human figure all against a barren landscape, which symbolizes the transience of time and the struggle of man against the unstoppable march of time towards death.
